title: Like reality, only better
titleChinese: 像现实一样，只不过更好？
paragraphs: We have been to the moon and sent spacecraft to Mars. But would you like to stroll on the red planet and examine the rocky surface of Mars close up from all angles?
Well, for those of us who can't afford our own rocket ship, experiences like this are now a virtual step closer, thanks to AR technology.
The letters stand for 'augmented reality', and even if it's not the most beautiful phrase in English, a lot of people in Silicon Valley think it will be the next big thing in tech.

AR refers to the process of displaying digital information on top of the physical world using an electronic device. The device could be a pair of smart glasses, a tablet or even a humble smartphone. And unlike 'virtual reality', or VR, users can physically move around and explore the digital world, instead of being restricted to a small area. This is particularly exciting for businesses.

Alex Kipman is the creator of the HoloLens - a headset which allows people to see and interact with holograms. During the 2016 TED Conference he even 'teleported' a hologram of a NASA scientist onto the stage with him, a stage which was transformed into a virtual Martian landscape.

In time, AR advocates hope it will allow us to interact with a whole world that is enhanced by multimedia provided by very clever computers - transforming not only business, but also fields like healthcare. A doctor could see patients around the world from the comfort of her own home.

Not everyone is convinced that either the technology or the world at large is ready. Google's pioneering pair of smart glasses, Google Glass, were deemed a "fascinating failure" by the BBC's technology correspondent.
And Kipman himself thinks we still have a long way to go before AR reaches its potential: "We will look back at this decade as being like cavemen in terms of technology," he said.

vocabulary.entry: spacecraft [n.] /ˈspeɪskrɑːft/ 航天器 (单复数同形)
vocabulary.example: The spacecraft is scheduled to land on Mars next month.
vocabulary.translation: 这艘航天器计划于下月在火星着陆。

vocabulary.entry: stroll [v.] /strəʊl/ 漫步；闲逛
vocabulary.example: We strolled along the beach at sunset.
vocabulary.translation: 我们在日落时分沿着海滩漫步。

vocabulary.entry: Martian [adj.] /ˈmɑːʃən/ 火星的
vocabulary.example: The Martian landscape is cold and barren.
vocabulary.translation: 火星的地表寒冷而贫瘠。

vocabulary.entry: virtual [adj.] /ˈvɜːtʃuəl/ 虚拟的 (专业词汇)
vocabulary.example: You can take a virtual tour of the museum online.
vocabulary.translation: 你可以在线进行博物馆的虚拟游览。

vocabulary.entry: augmented reality [n.] /ɔːɡˈmentɪd riˈæləti/ 增强现实 (专业词汇；缩写: AR)
vocabulary.example: Augmented reality adds digital elements to a live view of the real world.
vocabulary.translation: 增强现实将数字元素添加到真实世界的实时视图中。

vocabulary.entry: Silicon Valley [n.] /ˈsɪlɪkən ˈvæli/ 硅谷 (专有名词)
vocabulary.example: Many tech startups are based in Silicon Valley.
vocabulary.translation: 许多科技初创公司位于硅谷。

vocabulary.entry: digital information [n.] /ˈdɪdʒɪtəl ˌɪnfəˈmeɪʃən/ 数字信息 (专业词汇)
vocabulary.example: The internet allows us to access vast amounts of digital information.
vocabulary.translation: 互联网让我们能够访问海量的数字信息。

vocabulary.entry: smart glasses [n. pl.] /smɑːt ˈɡlɑːsɪz/ 智能眼镜 (单数: smart glass)
vocabulary.example: Smart glasses can display notifications directly in your field of vision.
vocabulary.translation: 智能眼镜可以直接在你的视野中显示通知。

vocabulary.entry: tablet [n.] /ˈtæblɪt/ 平板电脑
vocabulary.example: She uses her tablet to read e-books and browse the web.
vocabulary.translation: 她用平板电脑阅读电子书和浏览网页。

vocabulary.entry: humble [adj.] /ˈhʌmbəl/ 普通的；不起眼的
vocabulary.example: The humble smartphone has revolutionized communication.
vocabulary.translation: 普通的智能手机已经彻底改变了通信。

vocabulary.entry: virtual reality [n.] /ˈvɜːtʃuəl riˈæləti/ 虚拟现实 (专业词汇；缩写: VR)
vocabulary.example: Virtual reality immerses users in a completely artificial environment.
vocabulary.translation: 虚拟现实将用户沉浸在完全人造的环境中。

vocabulary.entry: hologram [n.] /ˈhɒləɡræm/ 全息图 (专业词汇)
vocabulary.example: The concert featured a hologram of a deceased singer.
vocabulary.translation: 这场音乐会使用了已故歌手的全息图。

vocabulary.entry: teleport [v.] /ˈtelɪpɔːt/ 传送 (科幻术语)
vocabulary.example: In science fiction, characters can teleport from one place to another instantly.
vocabulary.translation: 在科幻小说中，角色可以瞬间从一个地方传送到另一个地方。

vocabulary.entry: landscape [n.] /ˈlændskeɪp/ 景观；风景
vocabulary.example: The landscape of the Scottish Highlands is breathtaking.
vocabulary.translation: 苏格兰高地的风景令人叹为观止。

vocabulary.entry: multimedia [n.] /ˌmʌltiˈmiːdiə/ 多媒体 (专业词汇)
vocabulary.example: The presentation used multimedia to engage the audience.
vocabulary.translation: 演示使用多媒体来吸引观众。

vocabulary.entry: healthcare [n.] /ˈhelθkeə/ 医疗保健 (专业词汇)
vocabulary.example: The government is investing more money in healthcare.
vocabulary.translation: 政府正在向医疗保健投入更多资金。

vocabulary.entry: pioneering [adj.] /ˌpaɪəˈnɪərɪŋ/ 开创性的 (书面语)
vocabulary.example: The company made pioneering advances in artificial intelligence.
vocabulary.translation: 这家公司在人工智能领域取得了开创性的进展。

vocabulary.entry: fascinating failure [n.] /ˈfæsɪneɪtɪŋ ˈfeɪljə/ 引人入胜的失败 (固定搭配)
vocabulary.example: The product was technically impressive but a commercial flop – a fascinating failure.
vocabulary.translation: 这个产品在技术上令人印象深刻，但商业上失败了——一个引人入胜的失败。

vocabulary.entry: cavemen [n. pl.] /ˈkeɪvmen/ 穴居人 (单数: caveman)
vocabulary.example: Cavemen used simple tools made of stone.
vocabulary.translation: 穴居人使用石头制成的简单工具。

vocabulary.entry: at large [phr.] /ət lɑːdʒ/ 整个；全部 (固定搭配)
vocabulary.example: The decision affects the company and society at large.
vocabulary.translation: 这个决定影响到公司乃至整个社会。

vocabulary.entry: headset [n.] /ˈhedset/ 头戴设备；耳机
vocabulary.example: The virtual reality headset completely blocks out the outside world.
vocabulary.translation: 虚拟现实头戴设备完全隔绝了外部世界。

vocabulary.entry: interact with [phr.] /ˌɪntərˈækt wɪð/ 与……互动 (固定搭配)
vocabulary.example: Children learn by interacting with their environment.
vocabulary.translation: 孩子们通过与环境的互动来学习。

sentences.english: We have been to the moon and sent spacecraft to Mars.
sentences.chinese: 我们已登上了月球，并向火星发射了宇宙飞船。

sentences.chinese: 但你是否愿意在红色星球上漫步，从各个角度近距离观察火星的岩石表面呢？

sentences.english: Well, for those of us who can't afford our own rocket ship, experiences like this are now a virtual step closer, thanks to AR technology.
sentences.chinese: 对于那些买不起自己火箭飞船的人来说，现在这样的体验“实际上”离我们更近了一步，多亏了AR技术。

sentences.chinese: AR指的是使用电子设备在物质世界上显示数字信息的过程。

sentences.english: This is particularly exciting for businesses.
sentences.chinese: 这对企业来说尤其令人兴奋。

sentences.chinese: 亚历克斯·基普曼是HoloLens的创造者——这是一种让人们看到全息图并与之互动的头戴设备。

sentences.chinese: 医生可以舒适地在自己家中为世界各地的患者看病。

sentences.chinese: 基普曼本人认为，AR要实现其潜力还有很长的路要走：“未来我们回顾这十年，从科技角度而言我们就像穴居人，”他说。
